## 3. Date of Birth and its subsequent alteration  
[ Swamy's Complete Manual on Establishment and Administration ]  
1. Declaration of Date of Birth.Every new entrant to Government service should declare his Date of Birth by the Christian era at the time of initial appointment with documentary evidence, viz., Matriculation Certificate, Municipal Birth Certificate.
